from django.db import transaction
class _RB(Exception):
    pass
try:
    with transaction.atomic():
        from django.core.cache import cache
        from automation.models import Policy
        KEYS = ('core_settings', 'site_workstation_1', 'site_server_1', 'agent_x')
        def arm():
            for k in KEYS:
                cache.set(k, 1, 60)
        def gone(tag):
            print(tag, [k for k in KEYS if cache.get(k) is None])
        p = Policy.objects.get(pk=4)
        arm(); p.desc = 'x'; p.save(); gone('desc only')
        arm(); p.excluded_agents.add(1); p.save(); gone('exclusion')
        arm(); p.active = False; p.save(); gone('active')
        arm(); p.enforced = True; p.save(); gone('enforced')
        arm(); p.delete(); gone('delete')
        for k in KEYS:
            cache.delete(k)
        raise _RB
except _RB:
    pass
